name: Kyo Schwarz
source:
Race: Human, unknown heritage
Zodiac sign: Sagittarius
Age: Unknown
Weapon: Wind magic

Kyo is the captain of the black pirate ship Guardian Crow. He clothes himself in black, and part of his face is obscured by an eyepatch, and he has a black crow perched on his shoulder. Like his outer appearance, his history is also blackened, as he seems to have an unknown relationship with Nush. He is one of the Guardians of the Rig Veda, the protector of wind, and he fights using wind magic.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/seikai/seikai.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
